task: Apply the dependency security patch to the authentication library in the production service.

candidate_memories.content: Security patches to authentication libraries must be applied within 24 h of the CVE being published. Any auth library running a vulnerable version after the 24 h window triggers an automatic security incident classification.
CVE-2026-4471 published 18 h ago; auth-lib v2.3.1 is vulnerable; v2.3.2 contains the patch. 6 h remain in the 24 h SLA.
Update auth-lib in go.mod to v2.3.2; run go mod tidy; run make test; deploy via the standard release pipeline with expedited review.
Expedited security reviews require security-team approval in the PR; ping @security-oncall in the PR description.
